description: An open-air, sky-lit grazing meadow connector in a shallow grassy dell: a flat walkable floor between a south and a north island:socket, a worn dirt path spine, scattered scrub oaks, poppy/daisy/cornflower flowers, and a low mossy-cobblestone empty sheep fold (foreshadowing — the sheep are the Cyclops'). One of the two terrain connectors that link the beach camp to the mountain in the nobodys-cave-island remake.

style_fit.rationale: The purpose-built beach-to-mountain connector for the nobodys-cave-island remake (design brief §1): grass, scrub oaks, a worn dirt path, and the empty stone-wall sheep fold that foreshadows Polyphemus's flock. Through-walkable between two island:socket doorways at the shared floor_y=2 datum; open-air, sky-lit, renders clean at 1.21.11.
